newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian soldier killed in Chechen firefight.
newsitem.headline: Russian soldier killed in Chechen firefight.

text.p: A Russian soldier was killed in Chechnya during a half-hour exchange of fire at a command post in the southwestern suburbs of the capital Grozny, a spokesman for interior ministry forces said on Saturday.
The spokesman, quoted by Russian news agencies, said the incident, which happened in the previous 24 hours, was "a serious breach of all agreements that have been reached".
It was not, however, clear who attacked the command post.
Chechen separatist guerrillas, in control of most of Grozny since a battle in August, have for the past six weeks been keeping relative peace in the city, jointly with Russian troops.

Separatist leader Zelimkhan Yandarbiyev and Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin agreed in Moscow on Thursday to set up a joint commission to implement a peace accord signed on August 31 by Kremlin security chief Alexander Lebed and separatist chief-of-staff Aslan Maskhadov.
Many Russian politicians and army commanders in Chechnya have expressed strong reservations about the peace plan, which they say makes too many concessions to the rebels.
